items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is one call plus a short comment that says why it is there ("# Ensure base table is in alias_map."). It matches the reference fix and the style of the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing helper query.get_initial_alias() inside single_alias. Nothing is duplicated, no dead code is left behind, and Collector and QuerySet.delete are untouched.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: This is a minimal change on an existing path. No exception handling is needed and none was added, there are no magic constants, and all hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias by calling self.query.get_initial_alias() before counting aliases. Deletes with joins still count more than one alias, so they keep the pk__in subquery. The MySQL compiler benefits from the same fix, with no special case for .all().
